name: Evidence Interaction Hinge
ascii:
Legend: [D] = data structure/state, (O) = operation. Every named node maps to source code.

                              EVIDENCE INTERACTION HINGE

 (O) Mapped ASCII hinge
     src/components/AsciiSelectionGrid.tsx:AsciiSelectionGrid
       |
       +---- pointer-drag rectangle ---->
       |
       |    (O) Rectangle -> RefBufferContext
       |        src/components/DiagramView.tsx:completeSelection
       |        src/ref-buffer/RefBufferContext.tsx:RefBufferProvider
       |        normalize; intersect mapped spans in visual order; deduplicate
       |                 | selected mapped references
       |                 v
       |    (O) Selected Evidence -> call-graph focus
       |        src/callGraphFocus.ts:createCallGraphFocusRequest
       |        active diagram + provenance required -> focused context tab
       |
       | click mapped span / onReveal(mapping)
       v
 [D] Visual-to-Evidence map
     src/domain.ts:DiagramCodeEntityMapRecord
     artifact + ASCII SHA-256 revision; span -> entity id + range address
       | revision-checked mapping
       v
 (O) RepresentationIndex resolver
     src/representationIndex.ts:spatialEvidenceResolver
     visual element <-> EvidenceElementLink in one explicit index
       |
       +---- caller chooses one index ---->
       |    [D] No universal Evidence navigation
       |        src/representationIndex.ts:SpatialEvidenceResolver
       |        src/domainProfile.ts:ElementCommandContribution
       |        resolve only inside the caller-chosen RepresentationIndex
       |        commands support current tree/diagram; X no Evidence -> all representations
       |
       | resolved EvidenceElementLink
       v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| CODEENTITY-BACKED EVIDENCE HINGE                                              |
|                                                                               |
|  [D] Evidence -> CodeEntity compatibility                                     |
|      src/domainProfile.ts:EvidenceSchema; src/domainProfiles.ts:evidenceSchema |
|                                                                               |
|      built-in adapter: CodeEntityRecord => EvidenceEntity                     |
|      preserves identity, description, category, and source-range anchors      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       | entity + source-range identity
       |
       +---- toggle mapping-backed record ---->
       |    [D] Persistent Evidence highlights
       |        src/highlights.ts:HighlightRecordV2
       |        persisted revision + element + EvidenceElementLink
       |        reveal returns to the artifact and exact source range
       |
       +---- normalize repository path ------>
       |    (O) Evidence file associations
       |        src/fileTree.ts:diagramFileFilter
       |        local anchors indexed; missing, foreign, and invalid separated
       |
       v
 (O) Inspect Evidence and reveal source
     src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:CodeEntitiesPanel
     src/App.tsx:revealCodeEntity
     user selects entity and exact range; mapped reveal preselects that range
       | CorpusProvider read, or captured foreign snapshot
       v
 [D] Authoritative corpus anchors
     src/domain.ts:SourceRange / CodeEntityRecord
     src/domainProfile.ts:CorpusProvider
     reveal path, inclusive lines, symbol, and immutable original-line snapshot
